purpose: Run the single hosted DAO-versus-Rust read differential required for v1 verification.

decision_rule.accept: The provider is ready, all 98 inventory scenarios execute once, every artifact validates, every Rust coverage verdict is satisfied, and every successful DAO/Rust comparison projection is byte-identical.
decision_rule.reject: Any provider, generation, validation, coverage, comparison, completeness, or artifact-integrity failure rejects the acquisition.
decision_rule.retry: A failure after the first DAO mutation is a scientific result and is not retried without a new human decision.

publication.result_record: One additive EXP entry derived from the validated report JSON.
publication.support_matrix: Only verification states directly demonstrated by an accepted acquisition may change.
